term: A5 obtaining situations, rigid EVER-roster, causal coverage and nested reductio scope
resolution: A5P1 denies necessity of a whole conditional. On the ordinary classical falsity reading its counterinstance retains nonempty obtaining contingent situations as well as individual possible causability; neither an individual contingent bearer nor joint/actual causes follows. C fixes W’s particular current-or-past roster, unlike A3’s nonrigid beginning, but is not automatically a current slice or full future history. Step11 discharges only the inner C-necessary supposition; outer NoPossibleNB remains through17 and is discharged18–20 only to possible Necessary Being. Empty individual C is a negative obtaining situation, not empty Fact domain or necessarily no concreta. Earlier positive-caused CONTENT is borrowed, not re-asked or guaranteed retained on every entry route. Source-situation admission, same-C preservation, EVER/now, class and actual-concrete causal guards remain distinct from PSR fact-reasons or Ontic.Causes. Nonempty C’s prior-cause exclusion is a substantive whole-history causal commitment, not its truth alone, conjunction or SelfAct. Existing empty-history/count/modal results are conditional reuse, not source/application closure. Alternate P2C abbreviates the uncausability report and omits P1’s explicit obtaining/nonempty conditional guard while C3 restates it; their literal forms are not silently equated here. Revised individual class and stock situation-contingency vocabulary require separate scope review.
